instrument.evidence: The peptides were analyzed by liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS) on a SCIEX TripleTOF 5600+ instrument.
Samples were analyzed using a TripleTOF 5,600 MS (SCIEX, ThermoFisher (CHROMELEON7)) with a C18 trap column (3 cm × 100 μm) and analytical column (15 cm × 75 μm).
